invariants.rationale: className is used as a key in projectClassInfo.get; an explicit null check happens via a throw if not found, so must be non-null to reach method exit.

meta.value: className is checked for null indirectly via projectClassInfo.get(className)

invariants.rationale: classProperties is used in put operations and as a parameter to property-loading methods, so must be non-null at method exit.
classElement is used for property lookups during the iteration, so it must be non-null.
If classProperties is empty at method exit, classElement must also have had no corresponding values, due to the iteration logic.
A valid class name (used as a key for project class info) is likely non-empty.
